reason: Convert shaping_reward from always-negative to progress-delta to provide positive feedback for progress. Reduce crash_penalty to -50 to avoid overwhelming exploration. Make leg_contact_bonus one-shot event-gated to prevent farming. Add vertical_speed_penalty near ground to discourage hard landings. Relax success_bonus y threshold to 0.2 for reachability.
preserved_design: success_bonus as large sparse reward for true safe landing
changed_design: shaping_reward: from always-negative to progress-delta (change in distance and vertical speed)
leg_contact_bonus: from repeatable per-step to one-shot event-gated (first time both legs contact)
added vertical_speed_penalty: small penalty when near ground and vertical speed is high
success_bonus: relaxed y threshold from 0.1 to 0.2
required_edits_implemented: Increase the distinction between true terminal success and proxy progress states.
Add clearer negative feedback for unsafe terminal behavior without overwhelming exploration.
Treat fitness_score as auxiliary evidence; optimize the reward function for stable target behavior, not for a transient score peak.
Use final checkpoint behavior and target_behavior_report as the main diagnosis for the next reward edit.
Do not chase small auxiliary fitness gains when fitness_score_std or last-k variance is high; prefer clear behavior improvements.
Focus on controlled descent, near-ground stability, and terminal touchdown rather than action coverage.
Condition control incentives on reducing distance/velocity/angle in the correct phase.
forbidden_edits_avoided: Do not preserve a reward design merely because a transient checkpoint reached high fitness.
Do not optimize generated_reward as a framework objective; use it only to diagnose what the policy learned to collect.
Do not spend the next edit only trying to increase action coverage; coverage is already solved.
target_behavior_plan: The revised reward provides positive progress-delta feedback for reducing distance and vertical speed, making longer useful episodes more rewarding than early crashes. The reduced crash_penalty (-50) still discourages crashing but does not dominate. The one-shot leg_contact_bonus rewards first ground contact without farming. The vertical_speed_penalty near ground encourages soft landing. The success_bonus with relaxed y threshold is more reachable.
action_coverage_plan: Action coverage is already 100%. No changes needed. The revised reward should increase main engine usage (action 2) for controlled descent.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1: progress-delta on distance and vertical speed encourages descending toward pad. Phase 2: progress-delta on vertical speed and distance, plus vertical_speed_penalty near ground, encourages controlled descent. Phase 3: success_bonus and one-shot leg_contact_bonus reward proper touchdown.
payment_mode_plan: leg_contact_bonus is now event-gated (one-shot) to prevent farming. All other positive terms are either sparse (success_bonus) or progress-delta (shaping_reward). No repeatable positive terms without success.
validation_metrics: Target behavior report must show final target_success=true or an explicitly improved behavior gap.
Report fitness_score_std, fitness_score_sem, last-k fitness std, and whether the behavior improvement exceeds evaluator noise.
